{{Quote|We just keep building and building, but never stop to think about the impact on private commuters with their own vehicles.|PCF Chair [[Lysal Green]]|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|life/1352_1.html|Study Warns of Impending Parking Extinction}}</ref>}}
The '''Parking Conservation Fund (PCF)''' was a fund that was dedicated to saving and adding parking lots all over the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The PCF's Chair was [[Lysal Green]]. In 22 BBY, the fund issued a study after closely examining a decade of urban planning data and traffic trends. Their study predicted parking lots to become extinct in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]]. The PCF recommended planetary budget allotments to the preservation of parking-lands, and for planetary-funded creation of news lots. They recommended different ways Coruscant could alleviate the parking crisis without hindering urban growth, such as erecting two medium-sized lots for every [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] dealership built. The PCF's lobbying attempted to make their recommendations standard civic policy. They scored a victory by stalling the construction of an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] arboretum over the historic [[Soll's Pay-Later Lot]].
